calibrate_depth_with_method: calibrate predicted depth against ground truth using scale, scale-shift, or RANSAC method
calibrate_scale_shift_depth: compute scale and shift parameters via least squares to align predicted depth with ground truth
calibrate_scale_shift_RANSAC_depth: robustly estimate scale and shift for depth calibration using RANSAC regression to handle outliers
calibrate_scale_depth: compute a single scale factor by taking the median ratio of ground truth to predicted depth values
resize_small_depth_images: resize two depth images so the larger one matches the dimensions of the smaller one
